lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's forty-five? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 45? Nope!

lines.text: How many numbers from one to fifty are a sum of two or more consecutive whole numbers?
lines.caption: How many numbers from 1 to 50 are a sum of 2 or more consecutive whole numbers?

lines.text: Nine is four plus five, for example.
lines.caption: 9 is 4 plus 5, for example.

lines.text: Runs of two make every odd number from three up.
lines.caption: Runs of 2 make every odd number from 3 up.

lines.text: Runs of three, four and five light up most of the even numbers.
lines.caption: Runs of 3, 4 and 5 light up most of the even numbers.

lines.text: Runs of seven and eight add two more.
lines.caption: Runs of 7 and 8 add 2 more.

lines.text: Six cells stay dark: one, two, four, eight, sixteen and thirty-two. All powers of two!
lines.caption: 6 cells stay dark: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 and 32. All powers of 2!

lines.text: Forty-five was the trap. One fails too!
lines.caption: 45 was the trap. One fails too!

lines.text: Did you get forty-four? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 44? Tell me below!
